name: Document Loader: PDF Parser
description: Extract content from PDFs with Document Loader, using the PDF Parser PHP library.
project_description: A single DocumentLoader plugin for the Document Loader framework that extracts content from PDF files. Text is pulled with the local smalot/pdfparser PHP library, semantic HTML with ahmaadkhader/pdf-to-html, and Markdown by converting that HTML through league/html-to-markdown. PDF metadata (page count, author, title, etc.) is returned alongside every output. The plugin registers for the framework's built-in 'pdf' document type and advertises text, html and markdown output formats, so any module or AI tool that drives Document Loader can convert a PDF file URI without a separate web service. It ships no routes, permissions, config objects or Drush commands of its own; it is discovered automatically on the Document Loader settings page once enabled. Requires Document Loader 2.x and the three vendored PHP libraries (install via Composer).
